verdict.rationale: Attio markets a built-in 'Ask Attio' natural-language interface to search, update and create records, draft follow-ups and schedule next steps. It also says it can build workflows from a described goal and answer questions with live pipeline data. Separately, it documents connecting Claude or ChatGPT through an official MCP server to manage the workspace. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of Ask Attio's command scope and limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works as claimed.
